The "'''King of the Wampas'''" was an enormous [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] who lived on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It lived amongst the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]], where it became known as the "King of the Wampas" by the local [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who warned people to "avoid the King". The king was later killed by an individual.<ref name="Encounter"/>
